description: This file defines the MiniArrayRef template class, a lightweight array reference utility for C++ that provides various constructors, iterators, and comparison operations, used within the torch::aot_inductor namespace.

classes.name: MiniArrayRef
classes.description: A lightweight, non-owning reference to an array of elements of type T, supporting various constructors, iterators, and comparison operations.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the array.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the array.

methods.name: cbegin
methods.description: Returns a const iterator to the beginning of the array.

methods.name: cend
methods.description: Returns a const iterator to the end of the array.

methods.name: rbegin
methods.description: Returns a reverse iterator to the beginning of the reversed array.

methods.name: rend
methods.description: Returns a reverse iterator to the end of the reversed array.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the array is empty.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the underlying data.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the array.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks element-wise equality with another MiniArrayRef.
